smoothscroll.config.title: Smooth Scrolling Config Screen
smoothscroll.config.notes.1: Smoothness values are in %. Scrolling speed values are in pixels.
smoothscroll.config.notes.2: 0 % means animation off (no smoothness) and bigger values mean slower animation speed (high smoothness).
smoothscroll.config.notes.3: Press F3+T in a world to update the config.
smoothscroll.config.notes.4: To access config ingame, use the mod modmenu.
smoothscroll.config.creative_screen.comp: Improves compatibility with some resource packs at the cost of some small visual corruption.
smoothscroll.config.tooltip.custom_curso: Disable this if you're having problems when you move the cursor with arrows
smoothscroll.config.tooltip.hotbar_stati: Moves the whole hotbar instead of the selector. This is experimental and the feature can be removed if it is hard to port.
smoothscroll.config.touchpad.inertia_dec: How slowly does the inertia slow down
smoothscroll.config.touchpad.inertia_sto: When inertia reaches this value, it abruptly stops
smoothscroll.config.touchpad.inertia_sta: How much scroll amount is needed in order to apply inertia
smoothscroll.config.touchpad.threshold.t: Scroll amount below this value is considered touchpad scrolled
smoothscroll.config.touchpad.time.toolti: How fast should scroll events be called in order to inherit being considered touchpad scrolled
